findings.head: 0776f8a7333fb23692fa37ad24ae95802b9e8b83
findings.assessment: Valid complete-read consistency gap: returned identities with a known latest observation time must carry exactly that per-row time.
findings.proposed_fix: Validate matching per-row timestamps for every returned ID when observedAt is known; reject missing or mismatched values while preserving untimed legacy membership, unreturned-row times and successful empty observations.
findings.validation_plan: Add constructor and raw decoder/load rejection tests with original-byte preservation, exact-match acceptance and untimed legacy migration roundtrip coverage. Rerun both current-head simulator families; prior iPhone passed 61 tests but iPad was canceled.
findings.resolution: Exact known-time returned-row timestamp validation is integrated. Constructor, decoder/load byte-preservation and timed/untimed legacy roundtrip tests pass on both exact-head simulator families: 63 passed, zero failed, including all 22 storage methods. Discussion resolved after verification.

findings.head: e5e647f5b5ec9e64f4a4df799e0a2dce75456351
findings.assessment: Valid FR-002 truthfulness gap: the successful-empty notice claims displayed runs were saved earlier even when committed history has no rows.
findings.proposed_fix: Condition the retained-row sentence on committed row presence in visible text and VoiceOver announcements; retain the neutral successful-empty sentence when no saved rows exist.
findings.validation_plan: Add model-backed absent, saved-empty and populated history coverage with failed-empty save rollback; expand existing UI assertions for first empty, prior empty, retained rows and save failure. Run both exact-corrective-head simulator families and fresh independent and Codex review before disposition.
findings.resolution: Successful-empty visible and announced text now condition the earlier-saved-row sentence on committed row presence. Absent, saved-empty, retained and failed-save cases pass on both exact-head simulator families; discussion resolved after verified disposition.

findings.head: e5e647f5b5ec9e64f4a4df799e0a2dce75456351
findings.assessment: Initial iPhone native log records selection assertions failing in chronological-row and large Dynamic Type UI tests before superseded-run cancellation. All 58 unit tests and six Foundation UI methods passed; no complete native-family pass is claimed.
findings.proposed_fix: Diagnose the actual selection/tap failure and prepare a minimal scoped app or test correction for the same reserved round before publication.
findings.validation_plan: Inspect complete iPhone and available iPad failure timelines; independently review the concrete proposed patch, then require both complete simulator families on the consolidated corrective head before disposition.
findings.resolution: The complete padded row label has an explicit rectangular hit shape. Original center taps, exact UUID selection and all 12 Dynamic Type assertions remain; trailing-whitespace selection is covered. Both formerly failing methods pass on both exact-head families. Each family has 75 passed, zero failed or skipped tests.

findings.head: 5e8e1612b6aa997563776e2c5f38952ccab4dcc1
findings.assessment: Both initial native builds fail: the LaunchContext initializer reads its published route getter before initialEntryPending is initialized. No simulator tests ran.
findings.proposed_fix: Compute the loaded initial route in a local constant, then assign route and initialEntryPending from that constant without reading self before initialization completes.
findings.validation_plan: Keep constructor, once-only entry, recovery and route-stability tests; require fresh exact-head macOS compilation and complete nonzero iPhone/iPad simulator suites after canonical correction reservation/import. Expected 88 methods is not execution evidence.
findings.resolution: Compute initialRoute in a local constant before assigning route and initialEntryPending. Root and independent reviewer separately verified both exact-head native full logs: builds succeeded and each family passed 88 tests with zero failures or skips (67 unit, 21 UI), including all constructor/entry/recovery/route-stability tests and all 12 Dynamic Type cases. Initial failure and proposed fix evidence remain retained.

findings.head: be7c25cb5e2e1bda63247314095896425f212f98
findings.assessment: Both initial cancelled native logs contain six genuine FoundationUITests.swift:35 assertion failures: the added Done helper expects zero source reads after deliberate library entry, which correctly starts one. Both builds succeed, but no complete simulator suite passes. Current pure-import head has identical application/test bytes.
findings.proposed_fix: Keep original pre-entry zero-read assertions, add exact one-read assertion immediately before opening Settings after deliberate library entry, and assert the same one read after whole-flow Done. Preserve access request counts, every existing test and production/fixture/workflow behavior.
findings.validation_plan: After actual canonical round-one reservation and verified pure signed import, publish one consolidated scoped FoundationUITests helper correction. Require fresh exact-head deterministic checks, actual full iPhone/iPad native builds and nonzero complete simulator suites, independent review and current bot review. Cancelled partial logs and declared 89 methods are not passing evidence.

findings.head: c37d7b5171912075ff7f43c78bd26b62f254eb0c
findings.assessment: The unchanged-head retry confirms a second native failure. All 68 unit tests and 20 UI tests pass, but the cancelled fixture's second nested Settings request does not reach the synthetic provider: access-request-count remains one and the cancellation outcome never returns. The earlier attempt's complete passing iPhone suite remains retained evidence but cannot satisfy this failed current run.
findings.proposed_fix: Reveal and require a hittable nested HealthKit-access button and request button before tapping. Require both the expected failed/cancelled outcome and exact request count after each request, preserving the two-request assertion and all source-read assertions.
findings.validation_plan: After this canonical round-two reservation and verified pure signed import, publish one FoundationUITests-only correction. Require fresh current-head deterministic checks, full successful nonzero iPhone and iPad simulator suites, configured current-head bot review, independent review and all finding dispositions before integration.
